written: 2026-09-10, after the pilot ran and BEFORE any pilot result was inspected

exclusion_criteria.malformed: any parse failure in any cell
exclusion_criteria.ceiling: median modal_share across the 4 boundary checkpoints >= 0.95
exclusion_criteria.near_random: pooled effective_support (n=48) >= 3.60 AND no checkpoint at modal_share >= 0.50

selection_rule.statistic: min over the 4 boundary checkpoints of effective_support
selection_rule.direction: descending; the 12 highest are frozen into the full battery
selection_rule.rationale: A max-min rule keeps the items that stay live at their WORST checkpoint, which is exactly what 'balanced across the vintage ladder' means. An item live at three checkpoints and collapsed at the fourth contributes nothing at the point where it collapsed.

forbidden_criteria: which option won in any cell
whether the two families agreed or disagreed
any vintage slope or temporal direction
forbidden_rationale: Screening on the dependent variable is the defect that disqualified FROZEN_22 from Stage 1. At n=12 the pilot is a screen, not an estimator; no temporal claim may be drawn from it.
